skill.name: email-assistant
skill.description: Guides Gmail MCP email reading, drafting, replying, and sending with concise replies and required user approval.
skill.summary: Draft and manage Gmail messages with approval-first workflows.

content.value_statement: Email replies can be slow and risky when an assistant sends too quickly. This skill drafts concise Gmail responses and requires approval before sending.
actual_capabilities: Guides listing, reading, searching, replying to, and sending Gmail messages through MCP tools.
Requires explicit user approval before any reply or new email is sent.
Drafts short email replies in the same language as the original message.
Provides a consistent draft format with recipient, subject, attachment, and body sections.
Asks which account to use when the account choice is unclear.
limitations: Requires Gmail MCP tools to be available in the user environment.
Does not provide Gmail authentication, permissions, or account setup.
Includes account labels that should be replaced before public distribution.
Does not verify facts inside email content without user-provided context.

use_cases.title: Handle Daily Inbox Replies
use_cases.description: Draft short replies to recent emails and wait for approval before sending them.

use_cases.title: Keep Team Responses Consistent
use_cases.description: Use one draft format for recipients, subjects, attachments, and message bodies.

use_cases.title: Respond Across Languages
use_cases.description: Reply in the same language as the original email while keeping the response concise.

prompt_templates.title: Check Recent Email
prompt_templates.prompt: Show my recent emails and summarize the important ones. Do not send any messages.

prompt_templates.title: Draft A Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the selected email and draft a short reply in the same language. Ask me before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare A New Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a new email to this recipient with this subject and message. Show the full draft before sending.

prompt_templates.title: Search And Reply
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for emails about this topic, identify the latest relevant thread, and draft a concise reply for my approval.

output_examples.input: Reply to the client in French and attach the requested file.
output_examples.output:
To: client@example.com
Subject: RE: Document requested
Attachment: file.pdf

Bonjour,

Veuillez trouver ci-joint le document demandé.

Cordialement,
[Name]

Ready to send?

output_examples.input: Send a new message asking for a project update.
output_examples.output:
To: teammate@example.com
Subject: Project update

Hello,

Could you please send the latest project update when available?

Best,
[Name]

Ready to send?

best_practices: Review every draft before approving a send action.
Provide the target account when managing multiple Gmail accounts.
Add missing facts or attachments before requesting the final draft.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the assistant to send messages without approval.
Do not include private account or secret-manager item names in shared skill files.
Do not rely on the draft as legal, medical, or financial advice.

faq.question: Can this skill send emails automatically?
faq.answer: No. The workflow requires explicit user approval before sending any reply or new message.

faq.question: Does it work without Gmail MCP tools?
faq.answer: No. The skill is written for environments that provide Gmail MCP email tools.

faq.question: Can it write replies in French?
faq.answer: Yes. It instructs the assistant to match the language of the original email.

faq.question: Can it manage attachments?
faq.answer: It includes attachments in the draft format when the tool environment supports them.

faq.question: Is it safe for multiple accounts?
faq.answer: It asks which account to use when unclear, but public copies should not include private account labels.

faq.question: Does it change email content after approval?
faq.answer: The intended workflow is to show the draft first, then send only after the user confirms.
